newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - KCM estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - KCM estimates raised.

text.p: -- CS First Boston raised its 1996 and 1997 earnings estimates for paper products company Kimberly Clark de Mexico SA.

-- Analysts Prabhas Panigrahi and Beatriz Castillo said the company should see its operating margins rise in the fourth quarter due to synergies from the recent merger with Crisoba, Scott Paper's Mexican subsidiary.
-- Panigrahi said that in a recent meeting with management, the company outlined cost savings of $40 million per year due to the synergies.
-- The analysts added that the recovery in Mexico's consumer sector still appears weak, however.
-- Kimberly Clark de Mexico is a subsidiary of U.S. paper company Kimberly Clark.
-- Kimberly Clark de Mexico shares were unchanged in early trade.
